meta.title: Collaborative Submission Review: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and determine whether Collaborative Submission Review is absent or refused when editing a vendor's submission.
Repeat the same collaborative submission edit as a Buyer and compare availability in the same tenant.
Observe or assert the tenant's RBAC configuration when access is granted to roles other than Buyer.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and determine whether Collaborative Submission Review is absent or refused when editing a vendor's submission.; Repeat the same collaborative submission edit as a Buyer and compare availability in the same tenant.; Observe or assert the tenant's RBAC configuration when access is granted to roles other than Buyer.

steps.note: Open an existing event as the closest available event context before the unsupported role-specific review action.

args.need: sign in as the non-Buyer user, attempt Collaborative Submission Review to edit a vendor submission, then repeat as a Buyer in the same tenant and report whether the action is refused, absent, or available

steps.note: The catalog cannot authenticate arbitrary personas or operate Collaborative Submission Review, so the tester must perform the requested role comparison.
Confirm the session remains free of visible crashes or server errors after the unsupported action is attempted.
